title: The Blazing Ninja
description: Despite the sacrifice of his own brother-in-law, a warrior leads an anti-Japanese rebellion in occupied China.

title: Deadend of Besiegers
description: A martial-arts expert helps Chinese villagers thwart pirates' theft of their town's priceless pearl.

title: Dragon Squad
description: The only surviving member of an escort party attempts to recover a case of stolen gold. He's accompanied by a con man and a drunkard.

title: Blood of the Dragon
description: White Dragon must get a list with the names of rebel supporters to Prince Ma Tang, the leader of the rebellion. Trying to stop him in his mission is the evil prime minister, who naturally wants the list so he can crush his opposition.

title: Born to Fight
description: When a Vietnam veteran is hired by a TV reporter to return to where he was tortured as a P.O.W., the fuse is lit for vengeance.

title: The Roundup
description: A police officer travels to Vietnam to extradite a suspect and discovers a murderer who has been targeting tourists for years.

title: Lone Wolf and Cub: Assassin on the Road to Hell
description: The story of a warrior named Ogami Itto and his son comes full circle.

title: Justice Ninja Style
description: When a cop murders and rapes a woman, he puts the blame on a local man who must prove his innocence.

title: Bruce and the Dragon Fist
description: Two schools of fighting vie for control of a village in northern Manchuria.

title: Gorgo: Ultimate Collector's Edition
description: A 250-foot monster wrecks London landmarks to free her baby, found by seamen (Bill Travers, William Sylvester) and put in a circus.

title: Kaiju Glam Metal Shark Attack
description: An accident from space has resulted in the creation of a Kaiju shark man! The wanton destruction has a pair of glam rock loving music fans worried that the concert they have been waiting the whole year for will be cancelled.

title: The Great Buddha Arrival
description: A gigantic statue of Buddha awakens and goes on a trek across Japan while the world watches in awe.

description: The warden of a 2022 prison sends an ex-Marine (Ray Liotta) to a jungle island where inmates are left to die.
